orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-archi.description: File a finished shift into its own archive folder, laid out like the live site, so the live files keep only open work.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-custo.description: Show every setting, template and catalog entry on one screen, and change only what the owner names.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-docto.description: Read-only diagnosis of the workspace, rules, markers, lease, watchman and deadline, with classified next actions; never repairs anything.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-hunt.description: Turn a request like "improve this project for 5 hours" into a shift from the ready catalog and start it, asking only for the hours when they are missing.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-impor.description: Stage explicitly selected GitHub issues onto the drafting table as quoted source; never searches or writes back.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-install-nightshi.description: Install the full Nightshift plugin, with its hooks and runtime, into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-night.description: Work a punch list to completion autonomously, overnight, through a todo list or until a product is polished, parking decisions instead of asking and leaving receipts.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-plan.description: Open the plan room to explore the code and design the work with the owner, building nothing until the owner leaves.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-plan-.description: Leave the plan room and name the next step toward building what was planned.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-purge.description: Permanently delete this project's Nightshift state, including punch lists, rules, receipts and archives; does not uninstall the plugin.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-quali.description: Compose a shift that works the project's quality debt across tests, code, accessibility, contracts, docs, dependencies and security.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-reset.description: Drop the runtime markers and deadline after damaged or confusing runtime state, without deleting the owner's work or evidence.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-sched.description: Print the launchd, cron or Task Scheduler config that starts a shift at a fixed time; registers nothing.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-setup.description: Scaffold .nightshift/ and propose quality gates for this stack in at most four questions, with every default on one screen; asks, never imposes.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-start.description: Begin the shift from the punch list with no prompts, so scheduled and headless runs behave like interactive ones.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-statu.description: Read-only shift status covering items, parked decisions, snags, the deadline and STOP or stall state; starts no work.

orwa-mahmoud-nightshift-nightshift-stop.description: Issue a stop-work order that pauses the shift now and leaves unfinished items open.
